name: Guiro scrape and cabasa groove
desc: vcsl guiro playing the long-short 'rasca' scrape (a down-stroke elongated, two up-ticks) with its speed alternating cycle to cycle, over a pumping cabasa 16th groove and a maraca ghost layer. Filters and pans drift on opposite phases; peak adds a rotating cabasa euclid and double-time scrape fills.

code.full: stack(s("[guiro@2 guiro guiro]*2").speed("<.95 1.15 1.1 1.2>").gain(${gain}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).room(.2).pan(sine.range(.4, .6).slow(24)), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.4, ${shk}).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(4000, 8000).slow(32)).pan(cosine.range(.35, .55).slow(16)), s("sh*8").gain("[.22 .1 .17 .1]*2").hpf(5000).pan(.64), s("cabasa(3,8,<0 2>)").gain(${gain}*.5).speed(1.3).hpf(2000).pan(.4)).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[guiro@2 guiro guiro]*2").speed("<.95 1.15 1.1 1.2>").gain(${gain}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.3).slow(12)).room(.2).pan(sine.range(.4, .6).slow(16)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.5, ${shk}).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(5000, 9000).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.32, .56).slow(12)), s("sh*16").gain("[.2 .09 .15 .08]*4").hpf(6000).pan(.66), s("cabasa(5,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${gain}*.5).speed(1.3).hpf(2200).pan(.38)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
